uncertain: The side-hall ramps, intermediate landings and upper-gallery outline are schematic; the two upper pylons are placed at area level.
Tsu'zee is a rare near the upper ramp. Illyanna and Ferra patrol; their circles do not mark a fixed spawn.
Shen'dralar Ancient placement is approximate. No unverified gallery-to-court jump is drawn.
notes: Original schematic for Vanilla/Classic 1.12; not to scale. Dashed outlines indicate unverified local geometry or approximate marker positions.
Panel positions are for page layout, not a common compass or measured elevation. Paired letters connect fields; arrows identify local vertical movement.
Boss numbering suggests a full-clear route including optional encounters; it is not a mandatory kill order. Return along the same path from dead ends unless a one-way transition is stated.
Five small diamond-and-cross symbols across the detail sheets represent the five pylons: one in the court, two upstairs, two in the prison. Clear the surrounding guards to disable them.
A requires backtracking after the upper circuit. B requires the Crescent Key or a suitable lock-opening method.
4 and 5 are one encounter, not two successive rooms.
